full_prompt_en: A square graphic watercolor illustration shows a blond boy sitting alone on a low grassy slope in the right foreground. He wears a red checked shirt, blue trousers, and dark shoes, with elbows resting on bent knees and his head lowered slightly. An open expanse of ochre-yellow grass leads left and back toward an isolated, worn wooden house near the horizon. The house has a steep roof, pale gray walls, a dark doorway, and no visible activity around it. Above, heavy blue-black storm clouds form a dense band, with lighter blue-gray breaks beneath them. A bare thin tree and a fence line sit near the house, emphasizing the emptiness of the field. Black pen contours describe the boy, roof, grass tufts, and distant fence; loose washes of mustard, tan, gray, and muted blue fill the larger areas. Fine scratchy hatch marks give the grass movement, while the sky is layered in darker, broader watercolor masses. The figure is small compared with the field and looming weather, yet the red shirt makes him the visual anchor. Light is subdued, with a narrow pale strip near the horizon separating the land from the storm. The whole composition feels quiet and lonely, balancing an intimate pause with the threatening scale of the open landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形钢笔水彩插画描绘一个金发男孩独坐在右前方的低矮草坡上。他穿红色格纹衬衫、蓝裤子和深色鞋，手肘靠在弯起的膝盖上，头略低。大片赭黄草地向左与后方延展，直到地平线附近一栋孤立陈旧的木屋。房子有陡屋顶、淡灰墙、深色门洞，周围没有可见活动。上方厚重蓝黑暴风云结成密带，下方有较浅蓝灰裂隙。一棵细瘦无叶树和一道栅栏靠近房子，更显田野空荡。黑色钢笔轮廓描出男孩、屋顶、草簇和远栅栏；松散的芥黄、棕黄、灰和低调蓝色水彩铺满大面。细碎刮擦般排线令草地有动感，天空则由更深、更宽的水彩色团叠起。男孩相对于草地和逼近的天气很小，但红衬衫令他成为视觉锚点。光线低沉，地平线附近一条窄淡色带把土地与风暴分开。整体安静而孤独，在贴近的停顿与广阔景观的压迫尺度之间求得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Graphic watercolor and pen drawing sets scratchy black contours over loose ochre, gray, and muted blue washes. Small repeated hatch marks animate dry surfaces, while broad dark washes gather overhead. A restrained red accent anchors a wide field of subdued color. Edges alternate between hard ink line, ragged brush edge, and unpainted paper. Diffuse storm light creates a pale low opening beneath a heavy upper band. The composition gives a small focal form generous surrounding space, producing an introspective, slightly ominous mood with visible handmade texture.
style_prompt_zh: 钢笔水彩插画把刮擦般黑色轮廓叠在松动的赭、灰和低调蓝色渲染上。重复的小排线激活干燥表面，宽阔深色水洗则聚在上方。克制红色点缀锚定大面积沉低配色。边缘在硬墨线、毛糙刷边与留白纸面间切换。弥散风暴光在厚重上方暗带下留出低处浅色开口。构图给予小焦点大块周围空间，呈内省而略不祥的情绪与可见手工肌理。
theme_en: A boy sitting alone in a yellow field before a storm
theme_zh: 暴风雨来临前独坐黄草地的男孩
name: Jeff Lemire
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
